blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Foreign Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro offered prayers on behalf of Filipino Catholics for Pope Leo XIV as he recovers from lung cancer surgery, during a meeting with a senior Vatican official marking 75 years of diplomatic relations between the Philippines and the Holy See.
